in_hebrew.name: Onida
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Onida הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Onida was a nymph who personified endurance and perseverance. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'onos,' meaning 'struggle.' In Christian tradition, Onida represents the unwavering faith and determination of those who face trials and tribulations.
